text:
tanya_sre: seeing a weird spike in BMC keepalive retransmits in apne3 since ~03:05 UTC, provisioning latency for gpu-pool-3 jumping from ~20s -> 2m+. Impacting autoscaler decisions. anyone else? :thinking:

alex_infra: yep saw alerts. netteam alerted about ARP table GC on oob-switches filling up, lots of sticky MACs from mgmt vlan.

raj_prov: reprovisioning logs show long waits on getting console via serial-over-lan (SOL). BMCs responding but TCP streams stall, then jump back. looks like keepalive storm + ARP churn.

keith_ops: cost note: autoscaler is spawning extra nodes to meet capacity which are being OOM-killed by our billing window. we already hit a one-hour warm quota earlier.

alex_infra: grabbing a sample from bmc-monitor: 
```
[03:06:12] bmc-monitor-bot: src=10.200.5.12 dst=10.200.5.254 keepalive_retx=12 conn_state=ESTABLISHED
[03:06:12] bmc-monitor-bot: src=10.200.5.13 dst=10.200.5.254 keepalive_retx=14 conn_state=ESTABLISHED
[03:06:13] switch: arp_gc_evictions=1864
```

tanya_sre: thanks. can we throttle heartbeats on the BMC mgmt agent temporarily? or rate-limit on the switch ACL?

raj_prov: quick mitigation I can push: reduce bmc-watchdog keepalive frequency via systemd drop-in for fleet-manager on jumphosts, and flush stale neighbour entries. patch looks like: 
```
# on jumphosts
sudo ip -s neigh flush all
sudo systemctl restart fleet-bmc-proxy
```

keith_ops: switch-side ACL works faster. netteam suggested per-src rate-limit for mgmt vlan at 100pps for a minute. less risk than changing firmware now.

tanya_sre: agree. alex, can you coordinate with netteam to apply ACL? i'll schedule the systemd tweak as fallback. we should avoid firmware toggle during peak.

alex_infra: pinged netteam (cc @net-team). they will apply a soft-rate limit to mgmt VLAN on apne3 core in 2 mins and monitor. deploy-bot reports current rollout status: 
```
deploy-bot: rollout/gpu-pool-3-scaling status=running progress=43% ETA=~8m
```

bmc-monitor-bot: alert suppressed: cluster.oob.arp_eviction > 1000 (apne3) -> hold.

raj_prov: after ip neigh flush on 3 jumphosts, a few SOL sessions recovered. provisioning latency down to ~35s on sampled nodes.

keith_ops: cost ops: pause autoscaler escalation for 10m to avoid throwing more instances until we stabilize. I'm putting a temporary hold in the autoscaler runbook.

tanya_sre: long-term: we should add BMC keepalive backoff in our bmc proxy (exponential) and gate firmware updates behind a canary that watches ARP/keepalive metrics. file an action item?

alex_infra: created GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/4287 "bmc-proxy: add keepalive backoff + canary gating". tagging prov and net.

raj_prov: note for postmortem: investigate DHCP lease timers on mgmt VLAN and whether we should extend ARP idle GC on oob switches.

tanya_sre: thanks everyone. current status: net ACL applied, neighbour flush done, autoscaler hold in place. monitoring for 15m. I'll update if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
